Small class sizes and personalised learning, supported by modern facilities and technology, including interactive whiteboards, laptop-equipped classrooms, a learning centre and dedicated IT support- Freedom to shape your teaching approach, with plenty of scope for educational innovation and streamlined administrative processes- Comprehensive induction and onboarding, including a buddy system throughout your first academic year, as well as support for ongoing professional development and trainingYour Responsibilities - A keen interest in modern teaching methods and contributing to the continuous development of teaching and learning- A strong commitment to personalised learning and enthusiasm for our bilingual educational approachAre you excited about making a difference, bringing your own ideas to the classroom and helping us shape the future of education? Corego is an event technology company powering large-scale events and festivals. Our seamless payment and access control solutions ensure smooth operations and effortless experiences for attendees and organizers alike. Combining technical innovation with deep industry expertise, we help bring ambitious live experiences to life.We are looking for a commercially minded and hands-on Customer Marketing Manager to support Corego’s growth across the German market. In this role, you will act as the local marketing and market insight partner for our sales teams, helping us identify, engage and build relationships with the right venues, events and target accounts. This is not a traditional marketing role. We’re looking for someone who understands how marketing, sales and customer insight connect — and who can turn that understanding into practical local execution that supports pipeline growth and customer relationships. You will work closely with Local Sales, Group Marketing, RevOps and other country marketing colleagues as part of a cross-country commercial team. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the market, translating strategy into action and making sure sales teams have the right insights, content and account data before customer outreach. Job Description- Your primary responsibility is to drive local account-based marketing execution in your market, ensuring that Corego is visible, relevant and well-positioned towards selected target accounts in the live events and venue industry. - You build and maintain local target account lists in close collaboration with Local Sales and help ensure that the sales team always has relevant account, customer and market insight before outreach. - You localise and adapt global campaign concepts, content and marketing assets to fit your own market, language and customer context. - You plan and execute local marketing activities, including trade fairs, hospitality events and other customer-facing initiatives that help build pipeline and strengthen relationships with target venues and event organisers. - You support and participate actively in customer-facing meetings as a marketing and insight expert alongside Local Sales, bringing relevant market understanding, campaign context and customer knowledge into the conversation. - You collect local market learnings, campaign results and customer insights, and feed them back to Group Marketing to support continuous improvement across countries. - You support the development of case stories, reference customers and local proof points from German events and venues, helping us show how Corego creates value in real customer environments. - You collaborate closely with Group Marketing, RevOps and other country marketing colleagues as part of the virtual commercial team, ensuring that local activities are aligned with Corego’s broader commercial priorities.Practical InformationThis is a permanent, full-time position. We are looking for someone to start as soon as possible, with the exact start date to be agreed individually.This role is primarily based at our Hamburg office, with the possibility of hybrid working. The role includes regular travel across Germany and the other countries that we operate in for customer meetings, trade fair, industry events and internal collaboration. You will work closely with colleagues across multiple countries and should be comfortable operating in a virtual, cross-border team environment. Who You Are- You have proven experience in marketing, preferably in account-based marketing, B2B marketing, field marketing or another commercially oriented marketing role. You understand how marketing supports sales and revenue growth, and you enjoy working close to commercial targets. - You are structured and detail-oriented, but also hands-on and practical. You are comfortable turning strategy into concrete local actions, whether that means preparing account insight, adapting campaign materials, supporting sales meetings or coordinating local events. - You work independently and take ownership, but you also enjoy being part of a collaborative, international team. You communicate clearly, share learnings proactively and understand the value of working closely with sales, marketing and revenue operations. - You are curious about customers and the live events industry. You enjoy understanding how venues, festivals, event organisers and hospitality businesses work — and how better insight, technology and commercial execution can help them grow. - You bring positive energy, a commercial mindset and an outcome-driven way of working. You are motivated by building something, improving how we work and contributing to the growth of a fast-moving scale-up environment. - You are fluent in both English and GermanNice to Have- Experience with HubSpot or similar marketing automation / CRM tools - Experience working in a scale-up or high-growth commercial transformation environment Why Corego?- Work on things that matter when it counts. When 40,000 people arrive at once, our payments, entry and data can’t blink. Your work powers the moments thousands of people remember, and you’ll see the results on site, not only on a dashboard.- Grow with a team that’s beside you. We started in Finland in 2015 and now work across the Nordics and DACH. You’ll work closely with experienced colleagues in several countries, learn fast, and have real room to build your own leadership path.- Be ambitious, stay yourself. We’re driven, professional and down-to-earth. We take the work seriously, not ourselves. You’ll find people who say what they think and celebrate when an event goes brilliantly.How to ApplyApply for the position by sending us your CV and a short cover letter in PDF form via the Connect button on our job website. In your application, please let us know your desired salary range and availability, including your earliest possible start date. The application period will remain open for two weeks and closes on 04.12.2026 at 15:00 EET. We actively review applications and interview candidates during the application period, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found. We therefore encourage you to apply as early as possible! Questions about the recruitment process or the open position? Experiencing technical issues with the application system? Please contact us at lara.henkes@corego.comWe will keep all applicants informed about the progress of the process. Please note that we only accept applications sent in English through the Connect button below and do not accept applications sent through email.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager Quant Risk and Valuation Solutions (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description: About InfrontAt Infront, we help major banks and independent wealth and asset managers make faster, smarter, compliant investment decisions. For decades, we have been at the heart of Europe’s financial services infrastructure, providing financial data and investment tools, from intelligent data feeds to wealth management platforms and trading solutions, and empowering over ninety thousand professionals to navigate complex markets with confidence.We build technology, but our people power us. We foster an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives drive innovation and results, guided by our shared values of engagement, communication and recognition. Together, we collaborate, commit to innovation and shape the future of our industry, building a culture of trust, transparency and enjoyment.About the rolePlease note: We’re building our team for 2027 and want to connect early with experienced professionals for this role. Applying means joining a first conversation with us, and you’ll be among the first we speak to when the role opens.Infront's Quant business - on top of Infronts market data - helps banks, asset managers, custodians, insurers and wealth managers make sense of complex and illiquid instruments. Our Valuation Data & Calculation Services deliver independent fair values for structured, private-debt, OTC and ABS positions, with white-box models that stand up to auditors and regulators.We are looking for a Senior Sales Executive based in Frankfurt to open new accounts for these solutions and turn them into measurable revenue. This is a new-business role: you will win customers, not manage existing ones. You own each opportunity from first conversation through negotiation and signature, and you translate valuation, risk and regulatory pain into a clear commercial case. Working closely with Infront Quant, Sales, Pre-Sales and Product colleagues, you will build the case for each customer. Once a deal closes, ongoing account ownership passes to the appropriate account-facing team, so you can keep your focus on winning the next opportunity.ResponsibilitiesYour focus is on opening and winning new business for Infront's Quant solutions, from first conversation through to signature. As our Senior Sales Executive, your key responsibilities will be:- Build and qualify a new-business pipeline among quantitative asset managers, institutional investors, banks and other financial-services firms.- Own complex sales cycles from prospecting to contract signature, including qualification, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, forecasting and CRM hygiene.- Lead discovery with decision-makers and technical or investment stakeholders, understanding their quantitative workflows, data requirements and business drivers.- Present and sell Infront Quant solutions in business terms, with support from Quant specialists and Pre-Sales.- Map each opportunity to a concrete use case, for example: independent fair values for illiquid assets, faster pricing of new structures, audit-ready valuation documentation,consolidating boutique valuation vendors, or a client-ready risk view that goes beyond a static PDF report.- Coordinate with SDR, Marketing, Quant, Product, Pre-Sales and Consulting colleagues, and provide a structured handover after the sale.- Attend industry events, conferences and specialist forums, and represent Infront at customer meetings.- Feed customer requirements and market intelligence back to Product and Quant teams.Who You AreYou combine commercial drive with the ability to make quantitative topics clear and relevant to business decision-makers. You can engage credibly with quantitative specialists and senior investment leaders alike.You are a strong match for this role if you:- Have 7+ years of successful B2B sales experience in financial software, market data, valuation, risk analytics or another complex technology environment.- Have a proven record of winning new customers and achieving sales targets in multi-stakeholder sales cycles.- Have relevant exposure to quantitative finance, institutional asset management, risk management, investment analytics or financial data.- Can translate technical or quantitative topics into compelling business value and a clear commercial case.- Have strong discovery, presentation, negotiation and executive communication skills.- Are business-fluent in German and English.It would also be an advantage if you:- Use a structured methodology such as MEDDICC and maintain disciplined pipeline management and CRM use.- Hold a degree in quantitative finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, computer science or a comparable field. This complements, rather than replaces, commercial experience.- Speak additional European languages.Our offerWhile our benefits may vary depending on your location, they typically include:Health & wellness: Benefit from wellbeing initiatives tailored to local needs, including access to an employee assistance programme that provides confidential support to employees and their families.Holiday: Enjoy competitive holiday entitlement aligned with local markets, so you can rest and recharge.Remote work: Enjoy the flexibility to work part of your week from home, with flexible working hours where possible. You may also request to work up to four weeks per year from a different location.Learning & development: Support your career progression with access to learning resources, ongoing conversations with your manager, and opportunities to share the knowledge you gain with your team.Culture & impact: Be part of an international team with a startup mindset and play a key role in making a meaningful impact.Our offices: Work from Europe's leading financial centres and be at the heart of where finance happens.Additional notes- Since your application will be reviewed by an international team, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English.- Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position, and applicants should have the right to work in the hiring location.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
